input: Apply for a local arts council micro-grant

gold.taskTitle: Apply for a Local Arts Council Micro-Grant
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to apply for a micro-grant offered by their local arts council to fund an arts-related project or initiative.

questions.title: Which specific arts council are you applying to?
questions.description: Identify the exact local arts council or funding body the user is targeting.

questions.title: What project or creative work needs the funding?
questions.description: Understand what specific artistic project, event, or initiative the grant would support.

questions.title: How much money are you hoping to request?
questions.description: Clarify the dollar amount the user intends to apply for within the micro-grant range.

questions.title: Have you applied for this grant before?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has prior experience with this specific application process.

questions.title: What is the application submission deadline?
questions.description: Establish the due date so the plan can be structured around it.

questions.title: What materials does the application require you to submit?
questions.description: Find out what components are needed, such as a project narrative, budget, portfolio, or references.

questions.title: Do you already have a draft or any materials prepared?
questions.description: Gauge how far along the user is so the plan starts at the right step.
